hotspots.title: Removes up to 100 tough stains
hotspots.text: Restores clothes to their former glory by removing 100 tough dried stains like curry, henna, ink, grease and many more.

hotspots.title: 6th Sense SoftMove
hotspots.text: 6th Sense SoftMove Technology delivers 18% better fabric care by using a combination of sensors and algorithms to choose from 6 customized drum movements for different types of fabrics.

hotspots.title: Steam Wash
hotspots.text: The Advanced Steam Wash Technology provides a sanitized laundry with the power of steam. It removes up to 99.9% bacteria and allergens, dust mites and virus.

hotspots.title: Wide Drum Access
hotspots.text: The 330 mm wide internal drum access makes loading and unloading laundry effortless.
